name: 74HC245D,653
title: 74HC245 / 74HCT245 octal bus transceiver with 3-state outputs
summary: Eight non-inverting bidirectional buffers between an A port and a B port, with 3-state outputs. DIR picks the direction of transfer and an active-LOW output enable (OE) turns both ports high-impedance when HIGH. The 74HC245 has CMOS input levels and runs from 2.0 V to 6.0 V; the 74HCT245 has TTL input levels and runs from 4.5 V to 5.5 V. Inputs carry clamp diodes, so with a series current-limiting resistor an input can be driven from a voltage above VCC. Packages are SO20, TSSOP20 and DHVQFN20, specified from -40 °C to +125 °C.

circuits.title: Test circuit for measuring switching times
circuits.description: Fixture for propagation delay, transition time and the enable and disable times. A pulse generator feeds the input under test, loaded to ground by RT, which matches the generator's output impedance. The output under test carries CL to ground, counting jig and probe capacitance, and RL to the common of S1, which ties RL to VCC, to GND or to nothing depending on the measurement (see the test data table). For delays the generator drives a data input (An or Bn); for enable and disable times it drives OE.

equations.name: Dynamic power dissipation
equations.expr: PD = CPD × VCC² × fi × N + Σ(CL × VCC² × fo)

where.CPD: power dissipation capacitance per transceiver, pF (30 pF typ for both types)

operation.text: With OE LOW and DIR HIGH the A lines are inputs and the B lines drive the A data; with OE LOW and DIR LOW the B lines are inputs and the A lines drive the B data. With OE HIGH both ports are high-impedance whatever DIR is.

The 74HC245 switches at CMOS levels that scale with VCC (VIH 3.15 V min, VIL 1.35 V max at 4.5 V). The 74HCT245 switches at TTL levels, VIH 2.0 V min and VIL 0.8 V max for VCC 4.5 V to 5.5 V. An HCT input held at VCC - 2.1 V adds supply current (ΔICC): up to 144 μA per data input, 540 μA on OE and 324 μA on DIR at 25 °C.
Every input has clamp diodes. A series current-limiting resistor lets an input be driven from a voltage higher than VCC; the clamp current limit is ±20 mA.
Outputs are specified at ±6.0 mA at VCC = 4.5 V and ±7.8 mA at VCC = 6.0 V; the absolute limit is ±35 mA per output, with 70 mA total through VCC and GND.
Input rise and fall rate is limited to 625 ns/V at VCC = 2.0 V, 139 ns/V at 4.5 V and 83 ns/V at 6.0 V for the 74HC245, and 139 ns/V at 4.5 V for the 74HCT245.
The DHVQFN20 exposed pad is not a ground pin, and the part works electrically and mechanically with it unsoldered. When it is soldered, its land may float or be tied to GND.
Complies with JEDEC JESD8C (2.7 V to 3.6 V) and JESD7A (2.0 V to 6.0 V). Characteristics are specified over -40 °C to +85 °C and over -40 °C to +125 °C, with typical figures at 25 °C.
